listNote: All 55 official PS5 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze.
sources: Trophy names, descriptions and grades: the official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide text is original to PLATINUM ROAD.

trophies.guide: The platinum itself: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are all on your card. There is nothing extra to hunt for this one — treat it as the finish line at the end of the highway and let the roadmap below carry you to it.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this is simply a matter of playing the first stretch of the story. Because it is a one-time scripted mission, keep a manual save before you start it if you want a clean replay point later.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through the story until Chapter 1 wraps up. Nothing here needs preparation — just follow the main markers and this signs itself as the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the main story. Keep pushing the primary mission thread and avoid long free-roam detours if you want the early chapters banked quickly.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. By now the map and side content open up, but this trophy only cares about the main storyline, so stay on the story markers until the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: See Chapter 4 through to its end. If a mission gives you trouble, stock up on armour and snacks beforehand rather than lowering your guard mid-fight.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: The final mission closes out the story and pays gold. Save in a separate slot before you start it: finales often branch, and a spare save means any choice-driven content stays reachable afterwards.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a named story mission — play it when it appears on the map. It is a one-time scripted job, so a save beforehand keeps it replayable if anything goes sideways.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a set-piece story mission. Go in with full armour and a stocked weapon wheel, follow the crew's callouts, and the trophy lands when the heist wraps.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Child's Play is a one-time story mission. Start it when it surfaces, play it to the end, and keep a save slot free beforehand in case you want to revisit how it played out.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Headliners is a scripted story mission with a showpiece setting. Play it through when it unlocks; there are no side requirements, just the mission itself from start to finish.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown plays out at the airport authority's turf. Bring a fast car for the approach, follow the mission markers, and finish the job to bank this one.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a full-scale story operation. Expect a longer mission: top up ammo and armour at the start, use cover during the big firefights, and see it through to the extraction.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The big gold: everything the game counts toward completion — story, strands, activities, collectibles and challenges. Work the other stages of this roadmap first and use the in-game completion checklist to chase the last percentage points.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Stunt jumps and stunt events scattered across Leonida all feed this counter. Grab a fast bike or car, clear a few stunts whenever you pass a ramp icon, and the 250 total arrives long before it feels like a grind.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are nine activity types to sample — races, fishing, shooting range, arcade and the rest. Swing by each icon once as you explore; a single attempt at each type is all this asks for.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: All 42 Shooting Range challenges need a gold medal. Learn each course's target pattern at bronze pace first, then speed-run it: accuracy bonuses matter less than never letting the multiplier drop.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun drone races run at 14 locations and you must win one at each. Practise the tight gates on your first attempt, then fly the racing line — cutting corners cleanly beats raw speed.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Twenty different race events need a first-place finish — repeats of the same race do not stack. Keep a car tuned for each class and work through the race icons county by county.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal talks a big game at the water's edge. Take his fishing challenge, match the bait to the spot's fish, and keep tension on the line without snapping it — land the bigger haul and he is beaten.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Find an arcade cabinet, sit down, and play one game through to completion. Pick the shortest cabinet game you can find — finishing is what counts, not the high score.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work Andy's strand whenever his marker appears and this unlocks at his last job. Because it is a character's final mission, the strand can close for good — keep a save before starting his endgame content.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand ends with this mission. Play his jobs in order as they surface, and save before the finale — once a character's last mission is done, their earlier content is gone.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy rides solo, and this is the last job on his strand. Follow his markers across the map, finish the final mission, and keep a pre-finale save if you like revisiting his earlier work.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight full stranger strands need completing, start to finish. Talk to every question-mark character you meet, then keep returning — most strands continue in stages and only count when the whole strand is done.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's supply runs build to one final mission. Clear his strand as it appears, and bank a save before the last job — final missions close a character's story for the rest of the playthrough.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand wraps up with this final mission. Work his jobs when they pop, finish the finale, and keep a spare save beforehand like with every character's last outing.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots spread over the state, usually somewhere scenic and quiet. Sit at each one until the prompt completes — a helicopter or fast travel between regions keeps the tour painless.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret wants one particular animal tracked and hunted. Take his lead, follow the trail clues in the marked area, and make the kill clean — the trophy is about that specific unique hunt, not general hunting.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Collectible cards hide all over Leonida, grouped into themed sets. Finish any three full sets — focus on one set at a time and sweep its locations in a single route so none get left behind.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: One hundred locations carry a WAiNK spot to interact with. They are quick stops — tag them whenever the icon shows on your route and use the counter here to pace the sweep region by region.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Challenges are the game's short-form objectives, and 50 completions are needed. They stack up naturally while doing everything else; if you fall short, the challenge list shows the quickest remaining ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner riding along, raise a four-star wanted level, then break line of sight and hide until the stars drain. Stick together the whole time — splitting up or losing your partner voids the escape.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Chain three shop robberies in one continuous wanted run with your partner beside you. Plan three nearby shops, keep moving between them, and never let the wanted level fully clear until the third till is empty.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: A vehicle counts as discovered once you get in and drive it. One hundred sounds like a lot, but stealing something new at every parking lot and dock gets you there well before the story ends.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Wait for a crowded firefight — five or more enemies in view — then trigger Combat Focus and drop them all before it ends. A weapon with a big magazine and headshots on the closest targets first makes it reliable.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA airport, get airborne or off the ground in a way the schedule never intended — grab a plane or aircraft and take off without clearance. Expect a wanted level; the trophy pops as you depart.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Rhinos are the military's tanks, and this cheeky description means getting up close with one — draw enough heat that the army rolls them out, then engage or commandeer one. Explosives and high ground keep you alive while you do it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Case a jewelry store first: note the guards and cameras, go in quiet, and keep every witness unaware until you are out. If an alarm trips or a single person spots you, leave and try a fresh store rather than forcing it.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Five bank vaults, five clean escapes. Scout each bank's exit route before you start, park a fast getaway car facing out, and lose the heat properly after each job — a robbery only counts once you have escaped.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks cruise set routes — ambush one away from crowds, crack it open with explosives or heavy fire, grab the cash and vanish. The escape is part of the deal, so have a route planned before the first shot.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: The state has 52 named areas and each must be visited at least once. Most reveal themselves during the story and side content; afterwards, compare your map against the fog and road-trip the gaps.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run illegal operations across the state, and each gang's operation must be robbed once. Hit one, note which colours it flew, and work through the remaining gangs — variety is the whole point.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, find the spot with the postcard view, and order the cocktail. It is a quiet one-off scene flagged here as a precaution — if a story event ever changes the beachfront, you will be glad you sipped early.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Get inside a vehicle showroom, take a car, and exit through the glass rather than the door. Any showroom car works — pick something with enough weight to carry you through the window in one hit.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and play a game with a proper follow-through finish. It is a leisure stop, so enjoy it — completing the game at the alley is what the trophy watches for.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The description points at a feel-good moment built around your partnership. Keep doing partner activities together — the public-facing ones where crowds gather — and this sentimental milestone signs itself when the moment lands.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: The game quietly counts the choices you make, and PSN tracks the total to 500. Dialogue picks, mission approaches and free-roam decisions all feed it — play decisively everywhere and it fills in the background.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: This one rewards a retry: fail at something the game lets you attempt again, then succeed on the second try. It is flagged as a precaution because a flawless run might never offer the moment — if it has not popped late in your playthrough, deliberately flub a repeatable attempt and nail the rematch.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Leonida hides something strange, and this pops when you witness it. Keep an eye on odd lights, sounds and out-of-place events while exploring remote corners at night — when the weird moment happens, stay and watch it play out.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: From a moving vehicle, swing a melee weapon into a pedestrian as you pass — the drive-by knockdown is the whole trick. Ride slow past a busy sidewalk on a bike or in an open car and time the swing as you draw level.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills from robberies can be pushed through your contacts to clean them, and the laundered total must reach $250,000. Feed every marked stack to the laundering contact instead of spending it raw, and use the counter here to pace it.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Cumulative spending across every shop in the game counts toward $100,000 — clothes, weapons, vehicles, services, all of it. There is no trick to rush it honestly; outfit both characters fully and it arrives mid-story.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Eight garage properties are on the market across Leonida. Buy each one as your cash allows — heist payouts and the laundering loop fund them — and the trophy signs when the last deed is yours.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Open the Scooter Bros app and register vehicles you own or drive — ten registrations in total. Every new car you keep is a candidate, so register as you acquire rather than saving it for one session.
trophies.name: On the Spot
